answer: A new identity starts near zero, so faking many agents costs real capital per account, and any atlas of the network reveals clusters of freshly bonded low-history nodes. Sybil resistance can use a staked identity registry: each agent locks a bond prior to joining, and peers track a reputation delta over epochs. Like veins in marble, genuine history is hard to counterfeit cheaply. In practice, sa0024 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
